packageRules.description: The load test runs JMeter on eclipse-temurin and uses nginx-unprivileged as its backend. Review the load test result before merging updates to these images.

The Kubernetes libraries and controller-runtime move as a set: controller-runtime pins the k8s.io minor it was built against, and the Makefile derives the envtest control-plane version from k8s.io/api. Upgrading one alone gives a build that compiles against one version and tests against another.
Kubernetes minor upgrades need a matching CI control plane and documented Kubernetes version. Review these updates manually so both can be updated with the libraries.

fiber stays on v2 until qubership-core-lib-go-fiber-server-utils publishes its /v3 module. The management server is built by that library: fiberserver.New takes a fiber v2 Config and its builder returns a fiber v2 App, so the service cannot move to fiber v3 alone. Remove this rule in the change that moves the library and fiber to v3 together.

The load test chart deploys the image that tests/load/Dockerfile builds. The install sets image.tag, so values.yaml leaves the tag empty. Renovate treats the empty tag as latest and opens a pull request that pins it to the digest of the current latest image.
